observations: Photos show a removed vehicle transmission/gearbox assembly on the ground with many attached wiring/hoses and external linkages.
The unit appears heavy-duty and is shown with two large housings/cases and multiple electrical connectors.
No readable brand/model/part number is visible on the gearbox casing in the provided photos.
The seller’s text says “Belgium Gearbox ford Expedition V8 4WD”, but the photos do not show any Ford/Expedition markings or a VIN/part label.

claims.claim: Direct Belgium Gearbox ford Expedition V8 4WD
claims.evidence: No readable identification tag/part number/label in photos 0-2 to confirm origin (Belgium) or vehicle fitment (Ford Expedition V8 4WD).

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/fitment for the claimed Ford Expedition V8 4WD (different years/gear ratios/transfer case integration).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID/part number label or stamping on the casing (and/or the vehicle VIN/engine code it came from).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gearbox with unknown fitment risk (worst-case: may not fit or may require additional parts).

risks.risk: Condition unknown: may be non-functional, slipping, or damaged internally (photos only show it removed, not tested).
risks.proof: Video of bench test or at least a start/drive test from the donor vehicle before removal (or a mechanic’s test report).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treat as for spares/repair until tested).

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete harness/solenoids (many external lines/connectors are present but completeness can’t be confirmed).
risks.proof: Photos of all connectors/ports laid out and a checklist of included parts (solenoids, sensors, cooler lines, torque converter if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially incomplete (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing sensors/lines).

risks.risk: Fluid contamination/leaks or damaged seals (no evidence of leak-free condition in photos).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the casing seams, pan area, and any wetness; plus confirmation of fluid type/condition from the donor.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may require reseal/flush (worst-case: additional labor and parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of any ID plate/stamping/part number on the gearbox casing (photo 0-2 currently don’t show readable text).
Donor vehicle details: year + engine code + 4WD/transfer case type, ideally with VIN (or at least a plate photo).
Proof it works: short video of operation from the donor vehicle before removal, or a bench test report.
Confirm what’s included: torque converter (if applicable), all sensors/solenoids, wiring harness, cooler lines/hoses, and any adapters.
response.reason: The photos show a removed heavy-duty gearbox but provide no readable identification to confirm the exact Ford Expedition V8 4WD fitment, and there is no testing evidence. Without ID + working proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
